% ================================================================ BEVFusion
\node[cam] (swin) at (4.6,17) {Swin-T\\+ GeneralizedLSSFPN};

\node[hdr] at (2.8,21.2) {DSB perception: BEVFusion (detection + BEV segmentation) and FlashOCC (occupancy)};

\node[note, anchor=north west, text width=20cm] at (2.8,20.6)
